messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up everyone — SOC2 + ISO evidence collection window is open. Key deadlines: internal teams must upload required artifacts by 2024-05-07, external contractors have until 2024-05-10. Auditor: Kumquat Associates will start sampling next week. Please use the compliance portal (link below) and follow the artifact naming convention. Privacy training completion is required for all employees before May 1 — People Ops will send reminders. :spiral_calendar:

Alex Rivera: where do we upload infra evidence? do logs count or do you want exports/snapshots?

Maria Chen: Upload to the portal -> https://compliance.internal.redwood/inbox (choose "SOC2-2024 intake"). For infra: we need permission screenshots + exported policies + one example log sample. Logs are fine as long as they are redacted for PII and cover the stated window. For S3 please include a `aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket <name> --query Policy` output or equivalent.

Priya Singh: quick Q — some contractors are on PTO and in APAC. Can we get an exception/extension for them? Also SSL cert renewals for staging are mid-May, will that be ok?

Maria Chen: @Priya we can allow contractors until 2024-05-10 as mentioned. For certs, if renewal falls after internal cutoff, include a ticket showing the scheduled renewal + screenshots of current certs.

Todd Hale: a couple of reminders: follow the least-privilege evidence (IAM screenshots, role bindings) and avoid including user PII in uploads. Tag uploads or tickets with `SOC2-2024` and the ticket number if you create one (eg TICKET-4528). Kumquat will sample about 10% of artifacts so keep filenames consistent.

Jenna Ortiz: People Ops reminder — privacy/e-lrn course "Data Handling Basics" must be completed by 2024-05-01. We'll auto-assign to anyone without completion and send a reminder tomorrow. If you already finished last year, please confirm in the portal under Training > Attestations.

compliance-bot: Automated reminder: 3 days until internal evidence deadline (2024-05-07). You have 3 outstanding items in the portal. See https://compliance.internal.redwood/queue

Alex Rivera: thanks — will upload infra artifacts EOD today. can someone share the quick checklist?

Maria Chen: checklist: 1) IAM role screenshots + list of principals; 2) S3 policy export + bucket ACL screenshot; 3) example app logs (redacted) for date range; 4) config screenshots for public endpoints; 5) training attestations screenshot. File naming convention: `SOC22024_<team>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>_<owneremail>`. Example: `SOC22024_ingest_S3policy_20240420_alex.rivera@redwood.com`. Full checklist + FAQ: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/SOC2+2024+Intake

security-bot: FYI — I ran a quick scan on staging certs. No expiring certs in the next 30 days.

Maria Chen: thanks all — ping me or open a ticket if you hit blockers. I'll consolidate uploads and confirm to Kumquat on 2024-05-08. :white_check_mark:
